verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents handoff or escalation rules for the Support Agent, whether by topic, sentiment, customer tier, or explicit customer request, and nothing shows the agent reliably obeys them. The closest items are adjacent rather than this capability: natural-language runbooks for unspecified scenarios, control over which issues the agent is assigned to, and general workflow triggers. These don't establish configurable handoff conditions, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, I configure when the agent must hand off — by topic, sentiment, customer tier, or explicit request — and it reliably obeys
